question: Summarize the key differences between evaluation protocol v1 and v2.
answer: Evaluation Protocol v2 splits the data 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% test. [S1] Protocol v2 uses k = 5 folds for cross-validation and reports mean and standard deviation of fold scores, while v1 did not detail this. [S1] Protocol v2 sets random_state=42 everywhere, a feature not mentioned in v1. [S1] Protocol v2 allows the test set to be used exactly once, unlike v1. [S1] For imbalanced data, the primary metric is F1 in v2, not specified in v1 [S1] [S2].

citations.title: Ml Project Handbook
citations.text:
Evaluation Protocol v2
Evaluation protocol v2 supersedes protocol v1 for all projects started in 2025. Split the data 70% training, 15% validation and 15% test. Use k = 5 folds for cross-validation and report the mean and standard deviation of the fold scores. Set random_state=42 everywhere. The test set may be used exactly once. The primary metric is F1 for imbalanced data and accuracy otherwise.
